name: Tornado Cash
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.97). Replaced keyword guess "frontend-infra".
rootCause: SlowMist founder Cos tweeted that there is a backdoor code in the Tornado Cash IPFS version frontend that hijacks deposit certificates. A governance attack led to malicious proposals being passed, and the malicious code has been present for about two months.
